infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Tenfold saves your finished videos to Photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tenfold opens videos you choose from Photos so it can edit them. Nothing is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Tenfold transcribes your videos on your iPhone to add captions and cut silences.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tenfold uses the camera to record clips for your batches. Recordings stay on your iPhone.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tenfold records sound with your clips and your voiceovers so it can add captions, cut pauses and mix your sound. Audio stays on your iPhone.

plugins.cameraPermission: Tenfold uses the camera to record clips for your batches. Recordings stay on your iPhone.
plugins.microphonePermission: Tenfold records sound with your clips and your voiceovers so it can add captions, cut pauses and mix your sound. Audio stays on your iPhone.

plugins.userTrackingPermission: Tenfold uses this only to see which ad brought you here, so we can spend less on ads that don't work. Your videos never leave your iPhone.
